_metadata.description: Server-owned durable remote runs (test-genie lifecycle reuse); survive disconnect; re-attach by id; stream results/logs back.

requirements.title: Durable Remote Execution & Result Collection
requirements.description: A dispatched job runs as a server-owned durable run on the node (reusing test-genie's run-lifecycle philosophy): it survives client and agent disconnect, is re-attachable by id with a block-once wait verb (no polling), and streams exit status, logs, and result artifacts back to the control plane for aggregation.

validation.notes: A run continues after the dispatching client disconnects and is re-attachable by run-id; wait returns exactly once with the real exit code.
Logs and result artifacts stream back from node to control plane and are persisted against the run-id.
Dispatch `scenario test X` to a node, drop the client, re-attach by id, and read the verdict + logs.
